overview: Based on the published agenda, this special meeting of the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to consider an early start resolution for the 2027-2028 school year and approve routine personnel actions through the consent agenda. The meeting focused on administrative matters including staffing changes and calendar planning for the upcoming academic year.

agenda.item: Resolution of Starting School Prior to September 1 for the 2027-2028 School Year (Action Requested)

discussions.item: Resolution of Starting School Prior to September 1 for the 2027-2028 School Year
discussions.body: Diana White was scheduled to present an early start resolution for the 2027-2028 school year for Board consideration. The presentation was estimated to take 5 minutes and addressed the district's calendar planning for the upcoming academic year.

The Board was expected to consider and approve a consent agenda encompassing multiple personnel matters, including appointments of additional and replacement staff with contract increases, separations including resignations and terminations, leaves of absence, and retirements.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on the early start resolution for the 2027-2028 school year
Action was requested to approve the consent agenda including staffing appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements
